using namespace std;
const int B=1e6, M=998244353, mod=1e9+7;
typedef long long ll;
ll n, count1, count2;
int total_sum[10], answer;
vector<int> values[10];

void generate_values(int depth, ll value) {
    if (depth > 6) return;
    int w = (++count1) - value + M;
    values[depth].push_back(w);
    total_sum[depth] = (total_sum[depth] + w) % mod;
    for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
        generate_values(depth + 1, value * 10 + digit);
    }
}

void process_v(ll v) {
    if (v > n) return;
    if (v < n / B && 10 * v > n / B) {
        for (int i = 0, power=1; i <= 6; ++i, power *= 10) {
            int w = (count2 + (ll)(M - power) * v + M) % M;
            int c = (int)(values[i].end() - lower_bound(values[i].begin(), values[i].end(), M - w));
            answer = (answer + (ll)values[i].size() * w + total_sum[i] + (ll)(mod - M) * c) % mod;
        }
        count2 += count1;
        return;
    }
    ++count2;
    answer = (answer + (count2 - v % M + M) % M) % mod;
    for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
        process_v(v * 10 + digit);
    }
}

int main() {
    cin >> n;
    generate_values(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
        sort(values[i].begin(), values[i].end());
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= 9; ++i) {
        process_v(i);
    }
    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
